summary:
I read all ten scripts in full (1,110 lines) and checked 490 claims against their primary sources. 480 hold and 10 do not: 1 WRONG, 0 UNSUPPORTED, 9 IMPRECISE. The record is /home/user/maps-architecture/docs/validation/retrovalidation-2026-10-18/scripts-verify.md, and its LANDED line is appended to docs/lane-events.log.

**Sources checked against:** PROGRESS J375–J391, the two top sections of HANDOFF, the outputs each run produced, and the host at 81f1cd96.

**Every script did what its J-row records.**
- 36 ran eight dimensions and carried T1–T3.
- 36b's replayed counts match fp-realm-review.md:89-90 exactly: 127 kept, 0 refuted, 36 missed.
- File m starts at item 659, after file l ended at 658.
- 37 produced faith-system.md (1,516 lines) with 12 problems and 17 omissions, as J380 records.
- 38 and 38b match J380 and J383, and 39 matches J381.
- 40–43 carry J382, J384 (1)–(13) and the gap rulings of J385–J388 exactly. Their numbering (780, 838, 878, 897) and their critic gap counts (15, 14, 6, 3) also match the records.

**Outputs and logs hold.**
- All 17 output files carry the J375 notice with the seat name the script gives, and the right title, numbering line and status line.
- All 10 LANDED lines the scripts prescribe are in the lane log.
- 38 host facts in the briefs hold, as do all 15 host line counts the scripts state.

**No script carries a design statement of its own that the texts lack.** The manager's extended reading in 36/36b, 40's kProsperity = 1.1^(relative rung) and 40's strength-order field are all ruled in fp-realm-review.md or V13.

**The one WRONG finding:** 36 and 36b tell a seat to read docs/DESIGN_FMG_WEAVE.md as merely "unread". That file does not exist at 81f1cd96, and fp-physical-integration.md:489 had already said so.

**The nine IMPRECISE findings:**
- "two territory rules" where there are three.
- The critic is asked about (T1) and (T2) only, then given (T3)'s terms.
- "File j items 131–141" all quoting the owner, though item 140 is a session ruling.
- 37 quotes the owner with "diety" silently corrected to "deity".
- 38/38b's meta text says "three systems".
- 38b's meta lists readers that were replayed, not run.
- Four host files named under src/domain/ that actually live in src/domain/worldPulse/.
- 41–43 tell the reviser "file n"; this did no harm.
- 41–43 carry a stale CONTEXT line.

**Not checked:** the run journals are not in the repository and were not searched outside it, so per-seat models and the scratch inputs are unverified. Historical line positions such as "V13 ~4,216 lines" can only be shown consistent with later files, not proven. Separately, HANDOFF.md:30-31 lists the scripts for the 38b and 39 runs as "—"; this is outside this family's files and is not counted as a finding.
